description: Eval cases for prune-comments: trigger accuracy, tier precedence, tightening fidelity, code safety, and the checkpoint accept/reject contract.

cases.prompt: clean up the AI comments in my pending changes
cases.intent: English trigger: activates jk:prune-comments on the pending diff.
assertions: Runs `git-checkpoint.py status` then `begin` without --full.
Ends with an Accept/Reject question.

cases.prompt: dọn comment rác trong diff này giúp mình
cases.intent: Vietnamese trigger.
assertions: Activates jk:prune-comments.
Summary is in Vietnamese; comments in code keep their original language.

cases.prompt: add JSDoc comments to every exported function in src/api
cases.intent: Adjacent negative: writing docs is not pruning.
assertions: Does not activate jk:prune-comments.

cases.fixture: pending file with `// ====== AUTH ======`, `// Step 1: validate`, `} // end if`, `// Updated to fix the bug`, and the two-line Stripe webhook retry comment
cases.intent: T3 junk deleted, T3 keep survives.
assertions: Banner, step narration, end marker, and change-log comments are deleted with deciding tier T3.
The Stripe webhook comment remains and keeps both facts.

cases.fixture: `// Helper function` directly above `// eslint-disable-next-line no-console` above `console.log(x)`
cases.intent: T0 protects tool directives even next to junk.
assertions: `// Helper function` is deleted.
`// eslint-disable-next-line no-console` is unchanged and still on the line directly above `console.log(x)`.

cases.intent: Explicit --junk naming a T0 pattern overrides it with a warning.
assertions: The eslint-disable-next-line comment is deleted.
Its summary row is marked T0⚠.

cases.fixture: junk-catalog.md `## Keep` entry: 'Step comments in migration scripts'; pending migrations/001.sql with `-- Step 1: add column`
cases.intent: Owner Keep outranks the antislop baseline and blocks tightening.
assertions: `-- Step 1: add column` is unchanged.
No summary row is emitted for it, or it is reported as kept by T2.

cases.fixture: `// Đơn hàng quá 30 ngày không được hoàn tiền, vì kế toán đã chốt sổ cuối tháng nên không thể hoàn` above a refund check
cases.intent: T1 keep leaves the comment untouched, including no tightening.
assertions: The Vietnamese comment is byte-identical after the run.

cases.fixture: three-line Safari resize workaround comment with a bugs.webkit.org link and version history
cases.intent: Tightening removes padding but keeps the link and the fact.
assertions: Result is one or two lines.
The bugs.webkit.org URL is still present.
Version history text is gone.

cases.fixture: `const url = "http://x.io"; // the url` and `total = a + b  # add a and b`
cases.intent: Trailing comment removal never alters code or string literals.
assertions: Lines become `const url = "http://x.io";` and `total = a + b`.
`git diff <ckpt>` contains no change to any string literal or expression.

cases.intent: No pending changes → ask instead of guessing.
assertions: `begin` exits 2 with no-changes.
Asks the user whether to scan the whole tree or stop; does not run --full on its own.

cases.fixture: pending changes with one file partially staged and one untracked file
cases.intent: Reject returns the repo to the exact pre-run state.
assertions: `reject` exits 0.
File contents, `git status --porcelain`, and `git write-tree` match the pre-run values.
No checkpoint commit remains in `git log`.

cases.fixture: state file from a previous unfinished run
cases.intent: Pending checkpoint is resolved before new work.
assertions: Reports the pending run and asks Accept/Reject for it before calling `begin`.

cases.fixture: `// Sum a and b` above `const total = sum(a + b)`; `// Check if list is empty` above `if (!list.length) return []`
cases.intent: T2: comments narrating code a mid-level dev reads at a glance are deleted.
assertions: Both comments are deleted with deciding tier T2.
The code lines are unchanged.

cases.fixture: `// Loop from 0 to length, and handle elements` above an index for-loop; `// Swap the two elements` above `[a[i], a[j]] = [a[j], a[i]]`
cases.intent: T2: industry-standard constructs and textbook algorithm steps are junk.
assertions: Both comments are deleted with deciding tier T2.

cases.fixture: new scaffolded component with `// Constructor` above `constructor() {}` and `// Your code here` inside a stub
cases.intent: T2: comments on boilerplate and stubs are junk.
assertions: Both comments are deleted with deciding tier T2.

cases.fixture: `setTimeout(focus, 0) // Safari needs a tick before focus` and `// Binary search is safe here: rows come sorted by createdAt from the index` above a binary search
cases.intent: T2 Keep (why, not what) beats T2 Junk even when the code is simple or textbook.
assertions: Both comments are byte-identical after the run.
Neither is tightened.

cases.fixture: `// Get the token from the header, decode it, and attach the user to the request` above a 15-line auth middleware
cases.intent: T2 'States what, not why' deletes a what-only comment even on complex code.
assertions: The comment is deleted with deciding tier T2.
No replacement comment is invented.

cases.fixture: `// Fetch user, then cache it for 5 minutes because the profile API is rate-limited` above a fetch-and-cache block
cases.intent: Mixed what + why keeps only the why.
assertions: Result keeps the rate-limit reason.
The 'fetch user, then cache' description is gone.

cases.fixture: `/** Returns the price in cents; throws RangeError when qty < 1. */` above `export function quote(qty)`
cases.intent: Public API contract Keep beats 'States what, not why'.
assertions: The doc comment is byte-identical after the run.
